name: Asa
source:
An average university student.

Asa is Zeph's soulmate.
Even after Zeph's death, the two still have a connection that pulls them together.

Asa is sweet and playful.
But he can be a little sadistic.
He's always smiling but under the facade, there's a skeleton in his closet.

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/our-fate-forsaken]itch.io[/url]]
